<!--
Thank you. A format report is safe to publish: by design it contains only file extensions,
magic-byte prefixes, counts and format->format relationships - no file names, no directory paths,
no file contents.

Generate one with:

  library_format op=report dir="<directory>"        # ~1.5 KB archive under $DSH_HOME/library/reports

Then paste the contents of manifest.txt below (or attach the .zip if you prefer). If you would
rather review before anything is produced, run `op=draft` first and select items explicitly.
-->
